text: Döntés: kész a 6,7 MB-os GLB 50 000 lappal, most előnézeteket renderelek, hogy megnézzem, áll-e a tárgy és ép-e.

The whole turntable disc is in the model as the largest connected component, and the Arduino sits on it. The disc is standing vertically, so the up axis is wrong. The 0.19 scale also applies to the whole disc, which would make the Arduino tiny. The fix is to remove the disc with mask_background and reconstruct again, about 20 minutes. The Arduino is flat, roughly 7 by 5 cm, so the scaling needs checking against a real measurement.

The 0.19 m figure doesn't match an Arduino Uno, which is about 6.9 cm, so the user may have measured the whole thing. I'll try fixing orientation first, but the bigger problem is that the disc is in the model, so I'm leaning toward masking it out and reconstructing, then revisiting the orientation afterward.

A COLMAP-igazítás rendben lefutott (76/76 kép), de a modellt a mintás korong uralja, és a tengely is függőleges; ezért a háttér maszkolásával kidobom a korongot, mert az Arduinót önállóan akarom megkapni.
Döntés: mind a 76 kép maszkolva van, ezért újra lefuttatom a rekonstrukciót 2000 px-lel a maszkolt képeken.
